subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Energy Density Explained
description: A short lesson to help you apply Energy Density Explained.

hook.text: A liter of gasoline holds about 100 times more energy than a liter of today's best battery.

buildup.text: Energy density measures how much energy fits into a given weight or volume of material.

discovery.text: Low energy density is why EV batteries weigh hundreds of kilograms to match a gas tank's range.

twist.text: But electric motors are so much more efficient that EVs need far less total energy to travel the same distance.

climax.text: Improving energy density by even 20 percent changes the entire EV equation—lighter, cheaper, longer range.

punchline.text: Batteries hold less energy but waste far less of it.

quiz.question: Why are EV batteries so heavy compared to gas tanks?
options: Battery energy density is much lower than gasoline

details.summary: Energy density measures how much energy a battery stores per unit of weight or volume. Higher energy density means longer driving range for the same battery size, making it a key performance metric.
details.whyItMatters: Energy density determines whether an EV can travel 200 or 400 miles on a single charge. Improvements in cell chemistry and design are steadily closing the range gap with gasoline vehicles.
takeaways: Gravimetric density measures energy per kilogram of battery
Volumetric density measures energy per liter of battery space
Current lithium-ion cells reach 250 to 300 watt-hours per kilogram

faq.question: How does EV battery energy density compare to gasoline?
faq.answer: Gasoline stores roughly 50 times more energy per kilogram than a lithium-ion battery. However, electric motors are about three times more efficient than engines, narrowing the practical gap considerably.

faq.question: What energy density would make EVs equal to gas cars in range?
faq.answer: At around 400 to 500 watt-hours per kilogram, batteries would provide gasoline-equivalent range in a similarly sized vehicle. Solid-state batteries aim for this level within the next decade.
